speaker: Howard
text: Oh, hey, Leonard. How was your day? Shut up. How could he just sit there and whip out a fly on me?

speaker: Leonard
text: Bite me. They were clever, Leonard. They exploited my complete lack of interest in what you were doing.

speaker: Howard
text: You should thank us. When future generations try to determine why your relationship with Penny crashed and burned, this right here is the black box. What are you talking about? The date went fine.

text: It's coming. Screen seven. Dude, she said she wants to slow things down.

text: Okay, so she said she wants to slow things down. It's like saying, I'm really enjoying this meal, I'm going to slow down and savor it.

speaker: Howard
text: No, it's like this fish tastes bad, so... I'm gonna slow down and spit it out.

text: You being the

text: I'm not the fish.

speaker: Howard
text: Oh, really? Did you make a second date?

text: No, we sort of decided to wing it.

speaker: Howard
text: Oh, even I know that's lame.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, all right, but let's assume your hypothesis. We went to dinner, we talked, we laughed, we kissed. Where did I possibly go wrong?

speaker: Howard
text: Think back, Leonard. The littlest things can set women off. Like, hey, the waitress is hot. I bet we could get her to come home with us. Or how much does your mom weigh? I want to know what I'm getting into.

speaker: Leonard
text: I didn't say anything like that.

text: Good, 'cause they don't work.

speaker: Rajesh
text: They also don't get it if you stare at them and hyperventilate. Sadly, that's my home run swing.

text: Look, everything went fine. I didn't even have to refer to my impromptu conversation starters. That woman across the hall is into me.

speaker: Howard
text: Let's go to the table. Look at her reaction to the goodnight kiss. No change in respiration, pupils undilated, no flushing of the chest.

speaker: Rajesh
text: Nice close-up, by the way.

speaker: Leonard
text: Interesting. Her jaws are clenched. No tongue access. Clearly a bad sign amongst mating humans. That's not a bad sign, please. You might as well have been to a iguana with no dewlap enlargement.

speaker: Rajesh
text: And the worst sign of all is you're here and not there.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm not there because I'm taking things slow. Which, by the way, compared to you guys, approaches warp speed. And take down that camera.

speaker: Rajesh
text: He was a lot more fun when he had no hope.
